description: Land Acquisition - Kandakula, Pathahewaheta D/S Division, Kandy District and Bossella, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, provides detailed descriptions of the properties (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and claimant information), and outlines procedures for compensation claims. This fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
